steps.caption: Open More in the sidebar, then Intelligence.
Filter by type of change: choose 'Decision-maker changed'.
Approver: Rahul Bhide → Kavita Menon. The old name is crossed out but kept.
Impact: the open Nimbus deal is affected and has been flagged for review.
Memory quality shows the same change with a caveat. Open the Quality tab.
The caveat: the new person's preferences and commercial authority are NOT copied from the old one — confirm them.
It also says which modules were told: deals, comparisons and scoring re-check the deal.
Recommendations: update the buying group and confirm Kavita's priorities and authority.
On the requirement, Decision-makers now lists Kavita as approver.
On the company, Rahul is still listed — marked 'left' — so the history is not lost.
Back in Changes, Acknowledge the change once you have dealt with it. It stays in the history.
